component.name: Advancely
component.summary: A highly customizable and interactive tool to track Minecraft progress beyond just Advancements.

description.p: Advancely is a sophisticated, data-driven progress tracker designed for Minecraft speedrunners, completionists, and content creators. Unlike other tools that only track vanilla advancements, Advancely can be configured to monitor virtually any goal you can imagine. It operates in real-time by watching your singleplayer save files for changes, meaning your progress is always up-to-date without any manual intervention. Its true power lies in its .json template system, which allows you to define exactly what you want to track for any version, mod, or playstyle.
The Zesskyo Update: introduces the new Compact Overlay Mode, heavily inspired by Zesskyo's All Advancements video.

ul.li: Compact Overlay Mode: a compact panel (with a new default background texture) shows the advancements/achievements count while all other goal types cycle in place on a single label. You pick exactly which goal types cycle: advancement and recipe criteria (separately), counters, multi-stats, complex advancements/achievements/recipes (version-aware), and custom goals, via multi-select dropdowns with icons.

Pop-out stack below the panel: goals pop out as they complete, right-aligned, with pop-in and disappearing animations. The stack respects multiple pops of the same goal, respects hidden items in its counts, and shows criteria and sub-stat icons. Hold time defaults to 60 seconds (max 15 minutes).

Manual-completion indicators in the compact mode: [o]/[x] in front of anything completable manually (x means checked off manually) and [a] when an auto-link completes a goal in the stack; the indicators are a toggleable setting.
Compact mode coop support: player faces on the panel and stack (positioning options in the Coop tab) with a player head size control, and no leftover spacing when no face is shown.
Promo text and a run completion screen with supporters on the compact overlay, plus a row-1 icon strip above the panel with its own icon size and horizontal spacing settings.
Fine-grained compact layout controls: panel line spacing, vertical spacing between panel and stack, and resizing/positioning of icons relative to the background textures.

Multi-stage stats now pop up whenever they change (not just on stage increase), sub-stats show on any update, and stats in multi-stage goals can use a -1 target value since stages can be completed by other means.
Coop fix: cumulative live Hermes syncing no longer double-counts stat-based multi-stage goal stages.
Template editor: imports can now replace existing templates, and pressing Enter on overwrite warnings (imports, copies, renames, creations) no longer skips the warning.
Visual layout editor performance: only items actually being moved are synced, and the per-frame template count rescan is disabled while editing.

Added/updated all_advancements _categorical templates for 1.12, 1.16.1, 1.16.2, 1.17, 1.18, 1.19, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3, plus a new 3D Wither Skeleton model and an updated 26.2 nether wastes texture.

Fixes: criteria stack count on first world load when multiple criteria pop the same frame (same for sub-stats), missing player face during the first Hermes read, face gap for parents, and overlay page repeat now defaults to on.

description.p: The Overlay Update: a major overhaul of the overlay, plus template editor improvements and important fixes.

ul.li: Overlay conveyor belt: all items now move perfectly in sync (no more jittering), completed items leave a gap that scrolls off-screen instead of snapping, and disappearing items fade out.
Dynamic overlay height: the window now sizes itself to the chosen font so row text can never overlap the row below, with separate Top Text Size and Row Text Size settings.
New Custom Vertical Spacing option: individually tune the gaps between each overlay row, with the window height adjusting to match.
Per-row scroll control: each row can use its own scroll speed and direction, and rows can auto-freeze (showing each item once, kept within the overlay borders) when few enough items remain.
New Page mode: a static, centered page of items that cuts to the next page like a book, with SPACE to advance manually.
The overlay now only restarts when an overlay-related setting actually changes (template and unrelated changes no longer bounce it), and static icons round to whole pixels to stay crisp.

Template editor: colored goal indicators (Hidden, Row 2/Row 3, etc.), searchable indicators and display names, reorganized editing buttons, and a proper rename that also renames the template's notes and snapshot files.
Template editor: creating, copying, or renaming a template can now replace an existing one with the same category and flag, and category/flag are split out correctly.

Cross-template imports: import across multiple language files at once, pre-select goals whose root name matches, select only new sub-goals, auto-scroll to imported goals, and get a warning (not an error) when importing from a different game era.

Visual layout editor: selections no longer pierce through windows and are preserved on save, checkmarks are non-selectable, checkboxes render as simplified squares for performance, and Reset Camera is now a button.
Fixed a severe memory leak in the overlay/tracker text-texture cache.
Every settings tooltip now lists its default value, the Hiding Mode dropdown fits all its options, and "Hide Template-Hidden Only" is the new default.

New and updated templates and textures: a 1.21.4 all_advancements template, 1.21.11+ categorical templates with 7 armadillo scutes, new 26.2 biome textures and biome icons, and completion fixes for the Netherite Upgrade trim and chest stat.
New per-stage option for multi-stage goals: a stage can be skipped automatically when the next stage is completed (used so the shells stage is skipped once the conduit is crafted).
Pressing TAB now cycles through the stage fields of multi-stage goals as expected.

Template editor: the Manual Layout checkbox is locked while the visual Layout Editor is active (and its previous state is restored afterward); selecting and dragging a goal together with its text no longer gives the text independent positioning (applies down the whole sub-goal hierarchy); pressing X on any search bar now reselects it.
Linked goals: a goal can no longer be linked to itself, a "Remove All" option was added, and Always On Top now defaults to off.
New templates: 1.16.2 and 1.17 all_advancements _categorical templates, plus 4 new old-block counter textures (grass block, netherrack, podzol, sand) for the 1.12 categorical template.

1.21.11 and 26.1 now share identical all_advancements templates (both ship the _categorical and _aatool_optimized variants, plus all their language and layout files), since they only differ in how the game files are read.

Template updates: all categorical templates were updated. Trident multi-stage goals were updated to account for tridents being lootable from chests, and shells/conduit stages now use the new skip-stage behavior across templates.
New textures: many old spawn egg textures, new end-screen emotes, and an updated old notch texture.
Added support for Minecraft 26.4.
Credits: added Oskar's YouTube.
Fixes: custom manual progress now transfers correctly when loading a settings preset.
For 1.12+ the "Advancements" tab in the template editor distinguishes between advancements and recipes.

Major rendering performance improvements for huge templates (like all_blocks): off-screen per-element culling now also applies to the manual layout, and text width calculations (CalcTextSize) are gated so they no longer run every frame for text that isn't even rendered.

New Cursor Reveal Radius setting: a radius around the moving mouse cursor reveals otherwise-hidden text and checkboxes, a massive performance win for dense templates like all_blocks. Max raised to 1024, and text now appears within the radius using its anchor point.
Welcome window: improved supporter message that now opens every 10 launches and after an auto-update.

New templates: 1.12 categorical template by ScrambledMC, plus an all_advancements coop template by magnissima. All other categorical templates updated, and the all_blocks template now carries a performance notice.
New textures: 26.2 icon textures, "Style" advancement textures in the newer categorical templates, and kittymmeow's half-done texture.
Fixes: settings.json writing now only carries forward existing true tracker-sync overrides, and saving no longer writes unnecessary .criteria keys.

Layout coordinates now live in their own per-template _layout file (like language files): a Layout dropdown in both settings and the template editor lets you keep multiple position sets per template, and create/copy/import/export/delete flows all respect layout files.
Settings Presets: save and switch between named settings configurations.

Template editor: invert-selection bulk action, selected goals can be added directly as linked goals, arrow keys nudge the selection in the visual layout editor, and goals can be imported from unzipped (unpacked) templates.
New templates: 1.16.1 all_advancements _ssg_blackcat, 1.16.1 all_blocks, and 26.1 / 26.2 all_advancements _aatool_optimized.
Template updates: 1.21 all_trims (added counter, renamed "Trims Counter" to "Trims") and the 26.1 / 26.2 categorical templates.
Coop: heartbeat hardening for more reliable syncing, and a lobby can no longer be started while the template editor is open.

Fixes: settings file read/write is now centralized to prevent corruption and partial reads, multiple Advancely instances can no longer run at once, and the auto-updater was overhauled to look cleaner.
Exported template zips now embed their exact version, category, and flag, so the import fields pre-fill correctly instead of being guessed from the filename.
The default template is now all_advancements _aatool_optimized; corrupted/missing-template recovery falls back to it.
Coop: complex advancements/achievements can be assigned to specific players; "auto" still tracks the player with the most criteria.
Goal hiding mode moved to a dropdown in the tracker controls and applies instantly without restarting the overlay.
More bulk actions for Recipe, Row 3, Row 2, and Per-Stage Icons checkboxes.
New templates: 1.6.4 all_achievements _ssg_kaimaseed, plus 26.1 and 26.2 categorical templates.
Fixes: main game files now take priority over the 5-minute Hermes re-read so advancements revoke properly; "Row 3" checkbox persists across template switches; note window no longer reverts on ESC.

Ghost players: contributors who appear in the world's advancements/stats/unlocks folder but aren't connected to the lobby still count toward combined progress, and can be selected from the player dropdown.
Auto-completion / linked goals now extend to multi-stage goal stages, with shells and trims wired up across all templates. Removing a goal that's linked from a stat also clears the link cleanly.
Inverted goal hiding mode: goals can fade in or brighten as they're completed instead of disappearing.
Custom completion threshold for the run (handy for Half% and similar categories).
Bulk-layout positions are now individually adjustable, and Progress Pos. is available in bulk selection once any complex advancement/achievement is picked.
"Use Game Capture" hint next to the Enable Overlay checkbox is now highlighted in orange for visibility.
"Syncing for <Player>" now also shows for offline/ghost players and works on the host side, not just the receiver.

Fixes: Hermes log file is redetected properly on new world creation; nested import popups' Select/Deselect All now respect the active search filter; renamed 1.14 and 1.15 all_advancements templates to their _optimized variants.

Cross-template imports on every main tab and on nested per-parent imports (criteria, sub-stats, stages). A Language dropdown picks the source lang file for display names, and any linked-goal refs that won't resolve after the import are flagged before you confirm.

Template update helpers in the advancement/achievement player-file import popup: preview new entries, detect renames by basename and ≥80% criteria overlap, prune stale entries, and apply criteria differences row by row. Every helper popup has its own search bar.
Advancement criteria grouping: multiple criteria can share a single progress slot, so packs like BlazeandCaves' "Ultimate Enchanter" track correctly.
Bulk actions consolidated under one button across all 10 editor lists: bulk delete, reorder, icon-path change, and manual layout positioning with automatic grid placement.
Every template now carries a built-in display_category; all official templates updated.

Fixes: corrected 1.12 - 1.12.2 root-name format checks on import, unsaved-changes popup no longer flickers behind the import popup, relay requires matching latest version (direct LAN only needs matching versions), coop face now respects text anchor, new-template-then-revert no longer leaves the editor in a stuck state.
Coop relay: large frames no longer disconnect receivers. Frames are now zlib-compressed, the size cap is gone, and slow consumers no longer block the rest of the room.
Player faces now show next to advancement criteria, indicating the player furthest along on that complex advancement.
Joining or rejoining a coop lobby no longer restarts the overlay window.
Cumulative is now the default stat merge mode for coop (was Highest).
Coop disconnect logs now include frame type, payload size, how far the read got, and timing info to distinguish stalls from instant closes.
Added Player Faces for Coop.
Some networking fixes and more detailed error codes.
Added 'Uh Oh' advancement to 26.2 template.
Added new MSYHBD.TTC font along with .ttc support. Hotkeys use key-capture input.
'Edit Templates' renamed to 'Open Template Editor'.
Overlay width saves properly again.
Supporters shown in welcome message.
Fixed folders opening up twice.
Fixed Linux certification path issue for installers.
Sub-stat progress text is now its own positionable element.
Fixed co-op sync issues where stat checkboxes and custom goal toggles wouldn't update properly between the host's view and the receiver's view, especially on individual player views.
Fixed the "All Players" view sometimes showing the wrong progress after toggling things, and not updating until the dropdown was clicked again.
Added a small warning under the Room Code field when the entered code doesn't match the expected format (6 letters/numbers).
Closing Advancely via the X on the Overlay window now properly asks for confirmation if a lobby is active or there are unsaved changes, and the overlay comes back if you cancel.
The merged player view now actually tracks the player with the most criteria for each advancement.
Small update to the Herdcraft template and a quick Hotfix for both the AUR Linux installers and NixOS distribution.
Co-op multiplayer: full Host/Receiver model with lobbies via relay server or directly through LAN. Coop supports EVERY minecraft version including legacy.

Co-op relay server: new official Advancely relay (TLS + cert pinning, hosted in New York) is now the default transport; no port forwarding or VPN required, just a 6-character room code and optional password.
Active Lobbies browser to discover open public rooms.
New timer formatting options: unit spacing (02 m 04 s 500 ms) and always-show-milliseconds.
Supporters list shown on every settings tab, sorted by donation amount.
Updated 1.16 all_advancements_categorical template.
Various fixes: browser links no longer open twice on Windows, "Run Completed" text respects the active view, moving windows no longer triggers a full file reload.
New '--relay-test' CLI flag for a one-shot TLS + cert-pin connectivity check.
Small fix with Ctrl/Cmd + F not working on the tracker.
Added support for 26.1.1 and 26w14a.
Added 26w14a all_advancements template.
